name: Euclid palette
note: Everything is derived in OKLCH. ladder: one L per step, the lightness of the neutral at that step. luminance: {equalize: 1} then moves every chromatic step to the OKLab L whose luminance equals the neutral's, so each row is one luminance and APCA contrast is the same across it (0 keeps equal OKLab L; between is a partial correction); anchors then find their step by luminance. from: apca spaces the steps by equal APCA contrast between top and bottom (against white, black, or both: the mean of the two solutions); from: uniform spaces them by equal OKLab L; from: base fits a curve to Tailwind's mean lightness per step; or give top, mid, bottom and gain, or an explicit lightness map. From the tail step a power term (exponent dive) carries the ladder to black at 1000, continuing its slope so there is no seam. Each family's hue is Tailwind's at the 500; as the ramp leaves the 500 the hue bends by a smooth function of hue (hueBend): a Fourier series with the given number of harmonics, fitted by least squares at build time to the measured drift of the reference palettes (base: Tailwind's own ramps; radix: palette/reference/radix-drift.json), times scale. Four harmonics fitted to Tailwind alone reproduce its drift within 3.3 degrees: shading bends toward red or blue, tinting toward yellow-green or pink; adding Radix to the fit flattens the warm tints and pushes amber onto yellow. Relative saturation is read off the Tailwind ramp at the ladder's lightness (chroma as a share of the Display P3 maximum); saturation multiplies that share. chroma: {from: bell} replaces the sampled shares with one bell over the ladder (a quadratic in step fitted to Tailwind's mean share) times a light and a dark number per family, fitted to its Tailwind ramp on either side of the 500. hues: anchors would place the unanchored families between the anchored ones at Tailwind's proportional spacing (it moves the greens about 10° yellower, so it is off). hueBend.shade and hueBend.tint are the default multipliers on each side of the bend (tint 0 holds tints at their pivot hue); a family's shadeBend and tintBend replace them. chromaCap caps chroma near white with a · (1 − L)^p, fitted to Tailwind's most chromatic family at each step from the 050 to the 400 (from: base) or given as a and p, times scale: it keeps a hue with a wide gamut near white (yellow) from taking far more chroma than its neighbours at the same step. Anchors are Byrne's red, yellow and blue: each shifts its family's hue by its difference from Tailwind at the anchor's lightness and marks the step nearest it; keepChroma also scales the family's chroma to the anchor's. hue sets a family's hue outright, hueShift and chroma adjust it by hand; the bend grows as |distance from the pivot|^ease (hueBend.ease, 1.5), so a ramp leaves the pivot without a corner; bendPivot is the step the bend starts from (500), bendEase a family's own ease, shadeBend and tintBend scale the bend on either side of it, shadeDrift and tintDrift add a family's own degrees at the 950 and the 050, and shadeChroma and tintChroma are chroma multipliers reached at those ends; naturalStep moves the circle off the computed cusp step. A family with between: [a, b] is a new ramp mixed from two Tailwind ramps (mix 0.5 is halfway) and placed after a. whiteMinLc: white text wherever it clears this APCA Lc. textMinLc: tinted text is the nearest family step clearing this Lc.
